data.notes: Priority (not a requirement) is given to applicants who do not already hold a bachelor's or master's degree, so this is in notes only. Applications must be submitted at least two weeks before the programme application deadline; applications are considered on a rolling basis. Award amount and type are not stated on the page. The page lists the eligible programmes by name; the nationality rule ALL is inferred because no nationality restriction is stated. The enrollment_status 'admitted' reflects the requirement to have an offer; 'enrolled' reflects the requirement to be a new student or displaced during current study. The degree levels bachelor and master are taken from the listed programmes (BSc, MSc, MA, LLM, LLB, MBA).
